question: The prosail 2.0.5 Python package (J. Gomez-Dans) checks itself against the PROSAIL Fortran reference distributed by Jussieu: its test case test_rsot_prosail5 runs PROSPECT-5 with leaf structure N = 1.5, chlorophyll 40 ug/cm2, carotenoids 8 ug/cm2, no brown pigment, equivalent water thickness 0.01 cm and dry matter 0.009 g/cm2, and 4SAIL with leaf area index 3, a spherical leaf angle distribution, hot spot 0.01, solar zenith 30 degrees, view zenith 10 degrees, relative azimuth 0, soil brightness 1 and the dry soil spectrum (psoil = 1), returning the bidirectional (SDR) reflectance. Reproduce this benchmark case with the registered model, then sweep leaf area index from 0 to 8 and plot the green (550 nm), red (670 nm), near-infrared (800 nm) and shortwave-infrared (1600 nm) reflectance against leaf area index on one chart. Describe how each band responds as the canopy closes and where it saturates, and state any benchmark setting the registered model cannot represent exactly and what you used instead.
